sets.experiment_title: Deep mutational scanning of the human insulin receptor ectodomain
sets.experiment_method:
Variants were generated using nicking mutagenesis and uniquely barcoded. The library was stably transfected into MEF cells, ensuring that each cell expressed a single variant. For surface expression analysis, cells were stained with two different fluorescently labeled monoclonal anti-human receptor antibodies and sorted into four bins based on fluorescence intensity. Genomic DNA was then extracted from each bin, and the barcode region was amplified and sequenced using Illumina technology. A functional score for each variant was calculated using a predefined scoring equation.
